abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Cardivel improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 6. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 9.9 | 5.0 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 12.8 | 6.4 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 10.3 | 5.2 | 650 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
